t,x,v,y=df['t'].values,df['x'].values,df['v'].values,df['dv_dt'].values
def fit(extra_fn, p0):
    def rf(p):
        cols=[t, 1/(1+p[0]*x)/v, np.exp(-p[1]*x**2)]+[extra_fn(p[2:])]+[np.ones_like(t)]
        A=np.column_stack(cols)
        coef=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)[0]
        return y-A@coef

            if best is None or val<best[0]: best=(val,s.x)

t,x,v,y=df['t'].values,df['x'].values,df['v'].values,df['dv_dt'].values
knots=np.linspace(0.5,8,11)
def hat(tt):
    H=np.zeros((len(tt),len(knots)))
    for k in range(len(knots)):
        e=np.zeros(len(knots));e[k]=1
        H[:,k]=np.interp(tt,knots,e)
    return H
H=hat(t)
def rf(p, b):
    G=H*(v**b)[:,None]
    A=np.column_stack([t,1/(1+p[0]*x)/v,np.exp(-p[1]*x**2),G])
    coef=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)[0]
    return y-A@coef, coef
